campuses.title: Bay Campus
campuses.text: Инженерия, бизнес, computer science. Новый кампус (2015), модернистская архитектура.

paragraphs: Swansea University is a public research university on the south coast of Wales — across the road from Swansea Bay and the Gower Peninsula. Founded in 1920, Swansea ranks in the world's top 350 (QS 2024) and is a UK top 30 for research (REF 2021). Strengths include engineering, computer science, law, business, and medicine.

International students enter via The College, Swansea University — Navitas's pathway college on the Swansea Bay Campus. International Foundation Year and Pre-Master programs lead into a Swansea Bachelor's or Master's degree.
paragraphsRu: Swansea University — государственный исследовательский университет на южном побережье Уэльса, напротив Swansea Bay и Gower Peninsula. Основан в 1920. Топ-350 мира (QS 2024), топ-30 UK по research (REF 2021). Сильные направления: инженерия, computer science, юриспруденция, бизнес, медицина.

Международные студенты заходят через The College, Swansea University — pathway-колледж Navitas на Swansea Bay Campus. International Foundation Year и Pre-Master программы ведут в бакалавриат / магистратуру Swansea.
